rows.label: tlk41100124_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Someone beat my high score
in TIGER! TIGER!...

rows.label: tlk41100124_05_msg0003
rows.name:
I was down about it, but I practiced
even harder.

rows.label: tlk41100124_05_msg0004
rows.name:
I trained morning to night, never
eating, even when my hands got
calluses and started bleeding...

rows.label: tlk41100124_05_msg0005
rows.name:
Until finally, I achieved a new
high score of 81,107 points!

rows.label: tlk41100124_05_msg0006
rows.name:
Nobody's EVER going to
beat this one. It's the
top record in all of Alst!
